I scheduled an appointment as I was interested in botox & ulthera. Reached the clinic but I had no consultation with the doctor. Receptionist told me to sit & looked at my face & basically implied that I needed 2x ulthera; which was fine but I would think a doctor & perhaps some scanning of my face would help to diagnose what I need would be better like how other clinics in Thailand do?
Then they took me to the room to apply numbing cream. Was informed it will take 45mins-1hr. By 1.5hrs, nobody came back even though I went to reception TWICE to ask for someone. Only after 2hrs of having numbing cream on my face, my face was already itchy & I really couldn’t feel anything but of course, nobody seem to care. Then I was I taken down to where they do the procedure on my face w the doctor. Then the assistant didn’t even apply enough gel on my face, and when ulthera started, it really hurt & I HAD TO TELL THEM to apply more gel as I’ve done this before. Why am I telling them how to do their job? I don’t know. Then the doctor & assistant just kept chatting till one stage, I can see she wasn’t even paying attention to where she was point the ulthera which was near my eye & she just went sorry sorry. Like okay… it’s just my face I trust you with so sorry will cut it 🤷🏽‍♀️ and lastly, doctor kept asking me to lift my forehead & frown in order to see my wrinkles but I couldn’t do it much as the numbing cream was on my face for so long & the doctor kept telling to do it till a point I told her I am doing it already but that’s all I can manage because of the numbing cream & the ulthera she has performed. Although staff are polite but it’s not how a proper clinic works. Overall customer service isn’t great, as they really don’t care abt wellbeing. I just hope the ulthera & botox works well (I’m sure it will) but I won’t go back again. I feel this place is overrated & just lacks a lot as compared to many other clinics I’ve been to in Thailand.

I never leave bad reviews, EVER, I rather just let it go than actually bother writing stories. But this was such a horrible experience I need it to be public.

Then in the appointment the doctor got frustrated, because she misunderstood what I was asking for, mostly because she was interrupting me all the time and talking over me and because of her English speaking level. And started yelling at my face in Thai.

Almost made made me cry as it shocked me so much, when all Thai people here have been so nice and genuine.

All this action happened in the 5 minutes I was there. It's not like I was there burning precious time going back and forth with what I needed her to do, that she would need to be so disrespectful.

After finishing her job, she immediately started asking about the service I had asked about last time that costs 1500-2500€ - which I was seriously considering then. I was so confused and thinking I would rather burn the money than bring it to this clinic, luckily there are bunch of other clinics here and in Phuket and Thailand and Asia to visit, no need to visit a place where you get yelled at, 9am in the morning on a Saturday for god's sake.

Also it looks like I have to visit another clinic and pay to fix the thing she was supposed to fix, because she did not fix it correctly as I requested and instructed. What a disappointment.
